answer: Problem: cloned agents dilute the reward pool. Mechanism: require every new identity to post a lotus-sealed compute receipt after a 75-minute task window; peers then run zephyr-weighted random audits that re-execute a 2% slice of claimed work. Cost: 0.35 POA bond and ~22s verifier CPU. Verification: checksum of audit outputs must match the receipt within 8 blocks. Failure handling: if a nebula of clones reuse one GPU queue, clock skew above 1.8s freezes payouts for 5 epochs.
